Description: "Fixed Old KOT dialog text invisibility by replacing theme-derived colors (CardDark, InputDark, TextSecondary, CardBorderDark) with explicit hardcoded dark colors. The Dialog composable was overriding the theme surface, making white text invisible on light backgrounds."
Instruction: "Replace the entire Old KOT dialog with the same layout but using hardcoded dark colors instead of theme-derived colors. Use Color(0xFF0d1117) for main background, Color(0xFF161b22) for header/footer, Color(0xFF21262d) for input areas, Color(0xFF30363d) for borders, Color(0xFF8b949e) for secondary text, Color(0xFFc9d1d9) for primary text."
